data.standardized_narrative: At 31 December 2020 the syndicate's opening gross claims outstanding (closing 2019) was GBP 389.009m. Analysis of the gross claims development triangle shows a net prior-year adverse development (strengthening) of approximately GBP 71.2m (c.18.3% of opening gross reserves), driven by adverse development on older underwriting years (notably 2016-2018). The syndicate cites the active 2020 Atlantic hurricane season, significant US wildfires and a number of large casualty and political risk losses as drivers; COVID-19 exposures were considered limited with reserves of GBP 15.6m net of reinsurance held for COVID-19 liabilities.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development (PYD) was not provided as a single gross 'movement' line in the notes. PYD was calculated from the gross claims development table (cumulative gross claims by underwriting year) on page 44 per the specified diagonal-method (excluding the two most recent underwriting years). exact_reserve_text is blank because no single explicit narrative sentence quantifying the gross prior year movement was found. Named event losses were quoted in USD ($36,800k) in the narrative; no GBP conversion was provided in the report, so event loss amounts are left null.
